summary: Compare publication and reconcile launch changes against the running incarnation's start evidence.

replay.detail: No claim replay or derived-table version change. Existing start and runtime observations remain the evidence sources.

schema.detail: Adds three seek indexes for runtime observations by origin and start successes by incarnation, including locally retained successes. Existing stores create these additive indexes at open; numeric schema version and stored claim bodies are unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; no coordinated member upgrade is required. Members on earlier builds still use their earlier launch comparison.

compatibility.detail: Publication preview uses running-launch evidence and can report restart when the selected declaration already matches the file but the running incarnation has drifted. Reconcile no longer borrows start evidence from a different incarnation. Existing adopted runtimes without matching launch evidence keep running. No public CLI option or resource field is added in this slice; mixed-build clients and fleets have not been exercised.

downtime.detail: No deliberate seat interruption is added. Index creation can delay API readiness when opening an existing store; restart-to-API and restart-to-health durations have not been measured on deployed store sizes.

manual.detail: No manual migration, identity change or operator action is required. Indexes install at normal store open.

recovery.detail: Earlier binaries can reopen these stores and ignore the additive indexes. Reinstalling an earlier binary preserves claims but restores its earlier launch-evidence comparison.
